program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (20.0, 16.0, 24.0),     # NMOS diff pair (weak inv. needed: vcm = 0.6 V)
    "L_in":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "I_t0":    (15e-6, 6e-6, 30e-6),   # fixed tail current (mirrored from IREF)
    "K_ab":    (125.0, 50.0, 400.0),   # adaptive-bias sense ratio Ipass/Ia
    "gmid_p":  (8.0, 5.0, 14.0),       # pass device gm/Id at ILOAD_MAX
    "L_p":     (0.3, 0.15, 0.6),
    "Cc":      (15e-12, 4e-12, 60e-12),
    "Rz":      (60e3, 5e3, 200e3),
    "Cf":      (1e-12, 0.1e-12, 10e-12),
    "Idiv":    (20e-6, 8e-6, 30e-6),
}

def _find_vgs(lut, dev, W, L, I, vds):
    lo, hi = 0.1, 1.8
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds)["Id"] < I:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def _m(W, wf=20.0):
    return int(max(1, min(200, math.ceil(W / wf))))

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = 1.8
    vref = spec["vref"]; vout_t = spec["vout_target"]
    imax = spec["iload_max"]; imin = spec["iload_min"]; CL = spec["cl"]
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    beta = vref / vout_t

    # ---- divider ----
    Idiv = p["Idiv"]
    R2 = vref / Idiv
    R1 = R2 * (vout_t / vref - 1.0)

    # ---- pass device (sized at heavy load) ----
    Ip_max = imax + Idiv
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], Ip_max, vds=vin - vout_t)
    Ip_min = imin + Idiv
    vsg_l = _find_vgs(lut, "p", mp.W, mp.L, Ip_min, vin - vout_t)
    opl = lut.op("p", mp.W, mp.L, vsg_l, vin - vout_t)
    gmp_l, gdsp_l = opl["gm"], opl["gds"]
    vgate_min = vin - mp.vgs

    # ---- adaptive bias: sense PMOS (1/K of pass) -> NMOS diode -> extra tail ----
    K = p["K_ab"]
    Ia_max = Ip_max / K
    Ia_min = Ip_min / K
    ms = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], Ia_max, vds=1.2)
    gmid_t, L_t = 16.0, 1.0
    mad = lut.size("n", gmid_t, L_t, Ia_max, vds=0.6)

    # ---- tail / bias mirror ----
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmid_t, L_t, iref, vds=0.5)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmid_t, L_t, p["I_t0"], vds=0.15)

    # ---- diff pair sized at mid tail current ----
    I_half_mid = 0.5 * (p["I_t0"] + 0.5 * Ia_max)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], I_half_mid, vds=0.65, vsb=0.1)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", 10.0, 1.0, I_half_mid, vds=1.0)

    # ---- small-signal at light / heavy load ----
    def ota(Itail):
        Ih = 0.5 * Itail
        vg1 = _find_vgs(lut, "n", m1.W, m1.L, Ih, 0.65)
        o1 = lut.op("n", m1.W, m1.L, vg1, 0.65)
        vg3 = _find_vgs(lut, "p", m3.W, m3.L, Ih, 1.0)
        o3 = lut.op("p", m3.W, m3.L, vg3, 0.8)
        return o1["gm"], o1["gds"] + o3["gds"], vg3
    It_l = p["I_t0"] + Ia_min
    It_h = p["I_t0"] + Ia_max
    gm1_l, go_l, _ = ota(It_l)
    gm1_h, go_h, vsg3_h = ota(It_h)
    A1_h = gm1_h / go_h
    A1_l = gm1_l / go_l

    Gdiv = 1.0 / (R1 + R2)
    Rout_h = 1.0 / (mp.gds + Gdiv)
    Cc, Rz, Cg = p["Cc"], p["Rz"], mp.cgg

    load_reg = 1.0 / (mp.gm * A1_h * beta)
    line_reg = 1.5 * mp.gds / (mp.gm * A1_h * beta)
    ugf_h = beta * gm1_h / Cc
    psrr_lin = ugf_h / (2 * PI * 1e3 * mp.gds * Rout_h)
    lg_dc = A1_h * beta * mp.gm * Rout_h
    psrr_lin = min(psrr_lin, lg_dc * mp.gm / max(mp.gds, 1e-12))
    psrr_db = db(psrr_lin)

    # stability bookkeeping (light load)
    ugf_l = beta * gm1_l / Cc
    p2_l = gmp_l / CL
    z_l = 1.0 / (Cc * max(Rz - 1.0 / gmp_l, 1.0))
    p3 = 1.0 / (Rz * Cg)
    pm_l = 180 - 90 + math.degrees(math.atan(ugf_l / z_l)) \
           - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf_l / p2_l)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf_l / p3))

    # transient: gate must move dVsg; slew with avg tail current
    dvsg = mp.vgs - vsg_l
    t_d = Cg * dvsg / (p["I_t0"] + 0.5 * Ia_max) + 20e-9
    tr = 100e-9
    if t_d < tr:
        us = 0.06 + imax * t_d ** 2 / (2 * tr * CL)
    else:
        us = 0.06 + imax * (t_d - tr / 2) / CL

    # systematic offset of 5T OTA (mirror node vs gate node)
    vd1 = vin - vsg3_h
    vos = abs(vd1 - vgate_min) * go_h / gm1_h
    vout_err = 100 * vos / beta / vout_t

    iq = iref + p["I_t0"] + Idiv + 2 * Ia_min

    # ---- netlist ----
    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # adaptive bias
    n.dev("MS", "na", "g", "vin", "vin", ms)
    n.dev("MAD", "na", "na", "vss", "vss", mad)
    n.dev("MTA", "tail", "na", "vss", "vss", mad)
    # OTA: fb -> diode side, vref -> output side
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "fb", "tail", "vss", m1, m=_m(m1.W, 10))
    n.dev("M2", "g", "vref", "tail", "vss", m1, m=_m(m1.W, 10))
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vin", "vin", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "g", "d1", "vin", "vin", m3)
    # pass device
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", mp, m=_m(mp.W, 25))
    # compensation
    n.R("RZ", "g", "x", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "x", "vout", Cc)
    n.C("CF", "vout", "fb", p["Cf"])
    # divider
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": vout_err,
        "iq": iq,
        "psrr_1k": psrr_db,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "undershoot": us,
        "ripple_settled": 0.002,
        "pm_light_deg": pm_l,
        "ugf_light_rad": ugf_l,
        "ugf_heavy_rad": ugf_h,
        "vgate_min": vgate_min,
        "W_pass_um": mp.W,
        "A1_dc_db": db(A1_h),
    }

events.topology: PMOS-pass LDO, NMOS-input 5T OTA (PMOS mirror, gate tracks vin) with adaptive tail bias, Miller Cc+Rz (LHP zero), Cf feed-forward across R1
